spec: D1087 (Vincent, Tue Nov 3, 2026, build card B-12)
_about: Ours, not a design copy. D1087: no more mint colour for Glimmerwell; wine replaces it. cobblecrest.json and act1_route2.json stay verbatim (AGENTS rule 8), so their Glimmerwell 'mint' lines and the two 'cord' lines (D1448: lanyard) are re-voiced at runtime here, the way detail_zz_day1.json re-voices interiors.json. The bunting and lamp wording matches design branch claude/b12-no-mint. Nothing is written to the save.

lineSwaps.text: A crowd fills the quarry floor. Mint-and-white bunting flaps over a little stage.
to: A crowd fills the quarry floor. Wine-and-white bunting flaps over a little stage.

lineSwaps.text: A soft mint glow pulses at the top of the side path.
to: A soft wine-red glow pulses at the top of the side path.

lineSwaps.text: Mint lamps hum on tall stands. Walklings doze under them, their colours washed out.
to: Wine-red lamps hum on tall stands. Walklings doze under them, their colours washed out.

lineSwaps.text: So. Being late on partner day. The jingle. The mint sticker. That was all one thing.
to: So. Being late on partner day. The jingle. The wine sticker. That was all one thing.

objPatch._note: game.js applyObjPatch, after every overlay. linesSet replaces only a key the object already has.

linesSet.else: Bunting in Glimmerwell wine and white. It smells like new paint.

linesSet.story.seal2: Hale says your lanyard's from the company, not him. His floor's still open, patient as stone.
A Tier 2 lanyard, huh? Doesn't open this gate, sorry. Nothing does. Have a bright day!
